# Doctor

`cockpit doctor` checks the bound workspace and this machine's installation. Every finding belongs to one registered check with a fixed tier: no flag, environment variable or pack key changes the tier of a check. Doctor prints the errors, then the warnings, each followed by a `fix:` line, and exits 1 when there is an error; otherwise it prints `doctor: OK` (with the count of warnings) and exits 0. `--strict` makes a warning fail too, `--online` adds the probes that need the network, and `--json` prints the verdict and every finding as data. `cockpit setup` ends with the same checks.

Hermes versions this kernel was checked against: 0.22, 0.23. A newer minor is accepted, with a note, only when a live probe of its hooks answers the recorded shapes.

A check marked **security** guards a boundary (the fence, the stored secrets, a seat's isolation): each is an error, and the list of them is pinned by `tests/contract/doctor-security.json`. In a line, a name in angle brackets is a value doctor fills in. *What resolves it* is the `fix:` line doctor prints under the finding; in it, `<subject>` is what the line is about, `<pack>` the pack's folder, `<Hermes home>` the Hermes home and `<plugin>` this plugin's folder.

## Errors

An error fails doctor and `cockpit setup`.

| Check | Security | Line | What resolves it |
|---|---|---|---|
| `prompt.missing` |  | `prompt <name> missing: <path>` | `write that file, or correct the prompts entry in <pack>/pack.yaml` |
| `egress.push-blocked` | **security** | `git push NOT blocked` | `the kernel's own deny list is damaged: put the plugin's code back (cockpit update apply)` |
| `egress.forge-write-blocked` | **security** | `gh pr create NOT blocked` | `the kernel's own deny list is damaged: put the plugin's code back (cockpit update apply)` |
| `egress.read-allowed` |  | `git status blocked` | `the kernel's own deny list is damaged: put the plugin's code back (cockpit update apply)` |
| `egress.allowed-read-denied` | **security** | `allowed.reads lists a command the kernel refuses: <entry>` | `take that line out of allowed.reads in <pack>/pack.yaml: the kernel refuses it whatever a pack lists, and an outward act goes through the outbox` |
| `egress.pack-refuses-read` |  | `the pack's own rules refuse <command> to a worker (<why>): its lanes cannot work` | `narrow that rule in <pack>/egress.yaml (or refused.commands in <pack>/pack.yaml) until git status, git diff and git log pass, or list the read under allowed.reads in <pack>/pack.yaml` |
| `egress.pattern-invalid` | **security** | `egress.yaml <key>: <pattern> is no regular expression (<exc>)` | `correct that entry of <subject> in <pack>: while it is no regular expression the hook cannot read the rule, and raises on a command instead of judging it` |
| `hermes.auto-decompose` | **security** | `auto_decompose is not false` | `cockpit setup (it writes kanban.auto_decompose: false into <Hermes home>/config.yaml)` |
| `hermes.review-dispatch` | **security** | `review_dispatch is not false` | `cockpit setup (it writes kanban.review_dispatch: false into <Hermes home>/config.yaml)` |
| `board.metadata` |  | `board metadata missing` | `cockpit setup` |
| `egress.hook-allowlisted` | **security** | `egress hook not allowlisted` | `cockpit setup` |
| `seat.not-applied` |  | `<lane> not applied` | `cockpit setup` |
| `seat.plugin` | **security** | `<name> plugins/ lacks <plugin['name']>`<br>`<name> plugins.enabled lacks <plugin['name']>` | `cockpit setup` |
| `seat.skill` |  | `<name> skills/ lacks <skill['name']>` | `cockpit setup --rerender --seat <subject>` |
| `seat.env-lane` | **security** | `<lane> env lacks COCKPIT_LANE` | `cockpit setup --rerender --seat <subject>` |
| `seat.env-browser-home` | **security** | `<lane> env lacks BH_HOME (lanes.browser_session): cockpit setup --rerender --seat <lane>` | `cockpit setup --rerender --seat <subject>` |
| `egress.production-hosts-empty` | **security** | `egress production_hosts is empty` | `list one pattern per production hostname under production_hosts in <pack>/egress.yaml, or declare no_production_hosts: true when the project has no production` |
| `egress.production-host-blocked` | **security** | `production host NOT blocked: <command>`<br>`production host NOT blocked` | `correct the pattern under production_hosts in <pack>/egress.yaml until it refuses that host` |
| `egress.host-probe-allowed` | **security** | `production_hosts refuses a command it must allow: <command>` | `narrow the pattern under production_hosts in <pack>/egress.yaml, or correct host_probes.allowed` |
| `provider.dependency-missing` |  | `Hermes's environment lacks <requirement>, a provider plugin's dependency` | `install that requirement into the environment Hermes runs in (hermes --print-runtime-command names its Python)` |
| `fence.editor-hook` | **security** | `cockpit's fence is not in <cursor_hooks_path()> (agent.cursor_hooks): run setup` | `cockpit setup` |
| `agent.home-missing` |  | `agent home missing` | `create that folder, or correct agent.home in <pack>/pack.yaml` |
| `skills.router-missing` |  | `skill router missing` | `write that file, or correct router in <pack>/skills.yaml` |
| `env-file.missing` | **security** | `env file missing <path>` | `create <subject> (chmod 600) outside every git tree, or drop it from seat_config env_files in <pack>/pack.yaml` |
| `env-file.readable` | **security** | `env file <path> is readable by others (chmod 600)` | `chmod 600 <subject>` |
| `env-file.in-git` | **security** | `env file <path> is inside a git tree` | `move <subject> out of the git tree and correct seat_config env_files in <pack>/pack.yaml` |
| `vault.locked` | **security** | `vault locked: the scrub index lacks logins added since (cockpit vault index)` | `cockpit vault index` |
| `vault.key-unsealed` | **security** | `vault key not sealed` | `cockpit vault init --key <fingerprint>` |
| `resume.hook-missing` |  | `resume hook missing` | `cockpit setup` |
| `resume.hook-unregistered` |  | `resume hook not registered` | `cockpit setup` |
| `seat.drift` | **security** | `seat render failed: <exc>`<br>`seat drift <lane> (cockpit setup --rerender --seat <lane>)`<br>`seat drift <seat_cockpit(lane)> (cockpit setup)`<br>`seat render failed <lane>: <exc>` | `cockpit setup --rerender` |
| `gateway.state` |  | `gateway state unreadable` | `hermes gateway status, then cockpit up` |

| `hermes.newer-unprobed` | **security** | `hermes <version> is not a version this plugin was checked against (<', '.join(HERMES_VERIFIED)>)` | `install Hermes 0.22 or 0.23, or a plugin checked against this Hermes (cockpit update check)` |
| `cron.not-registered` |  | `<action['name']> cron not registered` | `cockpit setup` |

## Warnings

A warning is printed as `warning: …` and fails doctor only under `--strict`.

| Check | Security | Line | What resolves it |
|---|---|---|---|
| `egress.unknown-key` |  | `egress.yaml: unknown key <key><f' (did you mean {close[0]}?)' if close else ''>: no kernel code reads it` | `rename that key in <pack>/egress.yaml to the key it was meant to be, or take it out` |
| `pack.text-for-list` |  | `<key> is one text where a list is expected: it is read letter by letter, each letter as an entry` | `` write <subject> as a list in <pack>: one entry per line, each after `- ` `` |
| `seat.memory-full` |  | `<lane> MEMORY.md not writable` | `shorten <Hermes home>/profiles/<subject>/memories/MEMORY.md under 600 characters, or divide its notes with a line holding §` |
| `provider.drift` |  | `<lane> ran its last two sessions on provider <used>, configured <configured>: another provider plugin may claim <configured>` | `hermes --profile <subject> plugins list, then remove the provider plugin that claims the same id` |
| `provider.dependencies-unchecked` |  | `provider dependencies not checked: <found>`<br>`provider dependencies not checked: <exc>` | ``cockpit doctor again once `hermes` answers: the provider plugins' requirements could not be asked`` |
| `staging.missing` |  | `staging.yaml missing` | `write <pack>/staging.yaml with an origins map, one name per origin (app: https://staging.example.test)` |
| `staging.origins-empty` |  | `staging origins empty` | `name at least one origin with its URL under origins in <pack>/staging.yaml` |
| `repos.no-gates` |  | `no repo gates` | `give one repo its test command under gates in <pack>/repos.yaml` |
| `helper.program-missing` |  | `<label>: <program> is not an executable file`<br>`<label>: <program> is not on PATH` | `make that program executable or put it on PATH, or correct its argv in <pack>/helpers.yaml` |
| `plugin.block-unchecked` |  | `plugins.<name>: the plugin is not installed, so its block is not checked` | `install that plugin (extra_plugins in <pack>/pack.yaml), or drop its block under plugins` |
| `vault.key-unsealed-empty` |  | `vault key not sealed` | `cockpit vault init --key <fingerprint>` |
| `cron.turned-off` |  | `<action['name']> cron is registered but the pack turns it off: run setup` | `cockpit setup` |
| `cron.schedule-differs` |  | `<action['name']> cron schedule differs` | `cockpit setup` |
| `desktop.stale-copy` |  | `Desktop runs a stale copy of the plugin UI (restart the Desktop; it re-copies on start)` | `restart the Desktop: it copies the plugin's UI again when it starts` |
| `coding.command-missing` |  | `providers.coding.command: <program> is not on PATH`<br>`providers.coding.command: <program> is not an executable file` | `install that program or put it on PATH, or correct providers.coding.command in <pack>/pack.yaml` |
| `tools.video` |  | `<name> not found: a failure video cannot be encoded or checked` | `install ffmpeg (it brings ffprobe) and put it on PATH` |
| `forge.cli-missing` |  | `gh is not on PATH` | ``install the forge's command line and put `gh` on PATH: nothing is published or watched without it`` |
| `forge.cli-login` |  | `gh is not signed in to the forge`<br>`gh auth status did not answer within <LOGIN_TIMEOUT> s`<br>`gh auth status could not run: <exc>` | `gh auth login` |
| `notify.unknown-event` |  | `notify.<event>: no kernel code sends an event of that name, so its command never runs` | `rename that key under notify in <pack>/pack.yaml to an event the kernel sends (standup, advisory, ready_for_review, updated_after_review, tracker_comment, pr_comments, rereview, pr_stale, pr_stale_review, ticket_done, or ci_<state>)` |
| `tracker.auth-env-unset` |  | `tracker.auth_env: <name> is not set in this environment` | `export <subject> where cockpit and the seats start, or correct tracker.auth_env in <pack>/pack.yaml` |
| `repos.path-missing` |  | `repo <name>: missing <path>` | `clone that repository there, or correct its path in <pack>/repos.yaml (a relative path starts at the workspace's parent)` |
| `python.yaml-missing` |  | `<program> lacks PyYAML and the plugin has no .venv`<br>`python3 is not on PATH and the plugin has no .venv`<br>`<program> could not be asked for PyYAML and the plugin has no .venv` | `python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -e . in <plugin>` |
| `pack.finding-labels` |  | `finding_labels <labels_problem>` | `write finding_labels in <pack>/pack.yaml as a list of tags, e.g. finding_labels: [B, Q]` |

## Notes

A note is printed as `note: …` after the verdict and never changes it.

| Check | Security | Line | What resolves it |
|---|---|---|---|
| `egress.no-production` |  | `egress no_production_hosts: the pack declares that this project has no production` |  |
| `hermes.note` |  | `hermes <version> is newer than the versions this plugin was checked against (<', '.join(HERMES_VERIFIED)>): its hooks answered the recorded shapes in a live probe, so doctor accepts it (the board, delegation and config shapes were not probed)`<br>`hermes <version>: the live hook probe did not pass, so the version stays unaccepted: <why>` |  |
